_note: Who signs each third-party image outside ghcr.io and Docker Hub, pinned by hand: adding an image needs its publisher's identity here, never discovered at run time. An entry is named by an image (its registry and path), never by a registry alone. A keyed publisher is its published public key; a keyless one is an OIDC issuer and subject; a publisher that signs nothing has an unsigned reason, and the check prints it as no signature published. An image on a registry named nowhere here fails, and an image outside ghcr.io and Docker Hub fails the age check whatever its entry says: an entry decides only who signs, and unsigned waives the signature, never the age.

gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12.source: the Fulcio certificate of the publisher's signature when the identity was pinned; the publisher is Google's distroless project

registry.k8s.io/kubectl.source: the Fulcio certificates of the publisher's signatures when the identities were pinned; the image is accepted when any one pinned identity verifies fully
